description: Send a request to a listing's x402 endpoint through Agentropolis and get the seller's raw response back (status, headers, body). Use it only for listings whose search result has buy='relay_x402' (links.call present); for any other listing, call the seller directly using get_kit_manifest. Flow: call without payment, receive HTTP 402 with the seller's payment requirements unchanged, sign a payment with your own wallet to the seller's payTo, then call again with payment_signature (x402 v2) or x_payment (v1). Agentropolis holds no keys or funds, never changes payTo or amount and charges no fee, but a signed payment you pass is forwarded and may be settled by the seller, so real money can move. Limits: seller's own https host only, 256 KB request, 2 MB response, 25 s timeout (longer for slow first-party kits), 20 calls/min per client. Example: {"id":"seenly.seenly-token-preflight","endpoint":"/api/token-preflight","method":"POST","body":{"chain":"base","tokenAddress":"0x4ed4E862860beD51a9570b96d89aF5E1B0Efefed"}}.

body.description: Request body. An object is sent as JSON; a string is sent as-is with content_type.

content_type.description: Content-Type for a string body, e.g. 'text/plain'. Ignored for object bodies (sent as application/json).

endpoint.description: Path (e.g. '/api/script') or full https URL on the seller's own host. Defaults to the listing's primary endpoint.

id.description: Listing id exactly as returned by search_kits results[].id, e.g. 'seenly.seenly-token-preflight' or 'mcp.io-github-owner-name'.

method.description: HTTP method; defaults to POST when a body is given, else GET.

payment_signature.description: Signed PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value (x402 v2) from your own wallet; forwarded unchanged. Omit on the first call.

x_payment.description: Signed X-PAYMENT header value (x402 v1) from your own wallet; forwarded unchanged. Omit on the first call.

Agentropolis makes no request to Coinbase and does not cache or republish Bazaar data (their terms forbid it). Read-only. Example: {"q":"web search"}.

q.description: Search words to prefill on Agentic.Market, e.g. 'image generation'. Omit for the home page.

Use it after search_kits to judge whether a listing is worth using; use get_kit_manifest instead when you need the machine-readable invoke contract (endpoints, schemas, payment offers). Read-only, no auth; logs an anonymous detail view for seller analytics. Unknown ids return an error result with error 'not_found'. Example: {"id":"seenly.seenly-token-preflight"}.

id.description: Listing id exactly as returned by search_kits results[].id, e.g. 'seenly.seenly-token-preflight' or 'mcp.io-github-owner-name'.

trust.description: Payment-verified trust; score null = no evidence

description: Get the kit.json v0.1 manifest for one listing: how to call it (HTTP, MCP or A2A endpoints), input/output schema references, payment offers (rail, network, asset, payTo, amount), discovery files and a trust summary. Use it when you are about to call a listing yourself; use get_kit for human-readable details and trust evidence, or call_kit to call an x402 listing through Agentropolis. Read-only, no auth. For seller-published kits this mirrors the seller's own kit.json; for seeded listings it is generated from public metadata and may be incomplete, so prefer the seller's live 402 challenge for exact prices. Example: {"id":"seenly.seenly-pitch-kit"}.

description: Get 30-day x402 paid-usage statistics per category, with wash trading filtered out: services with paid usage, verified buyers, settlements, median listed price and listings excluded for wash signals. Use it for market sizing or price benchmarking; to find individual tools use search_kits. Read-only, no parameters. Data: x402-list.com measured settlements (CC BY 4.0, attribute when quoting) plus Agentropolis wash filtering. Buyer counts are summed per service, so a wallet that pays several services is counted once per service. Same data as /stats and the weekly reports at /reports.

Use it to check provenance or the attribution required before citing results; it does not search listings (use search_kits). Read-only, no parameters.
name: list_sources

description: Search the Agentropolis index of 52,264 agent-usable listings (MCP servers, x402/MPP pay-per-call HTTP APIs, A2A agents and kits) by task keywords, with optional filters. Use it first when you need a tool for a task; then use get_kit for one listing's trust evidence and price, or get_kit_manifest for how to call it. Not for browsing categories (list_categories) or market totals (get_market_snapshot). Read-only, no auth, never pays. Ranking: BM25 text relevance, boosted by payment-verified trust and the earned Live-Tested badge; trust.score null means no payment evidence (not a negative signal). results[] is organic; featured[] is a separate, labelled Agentropolis Pro row (today only our own first-party kits, no fee paid) and sponsored[] is a separate, labelled 'Sponsored' array of hand-approved paid placements (usually empty; never affects ranking or trust; pass sponsored:false to omit it). Listed prices are hints; the seller's live HTTP 402 challenge is authoritative. Each search is logged anonymously (query text, no raw IP). Example: {"q":"web search","rail":"x402","max_price_usd":0.01,"min_trust":40}.

category.description: Category id from list_categories, e.g. 'web_search' or 'crypto_onchain_data'. Comma-separate to allow several.

kind.description: Restrict to one listing type: kit (packaged task API), http_api (pay-per-call HTTP API), mcp_server, a2a_agent. Omit for all.

limit.description: Number of organic results to return, 1-25 (default 10).

max_price_usd.description: Only listings whose lowest listed price per call/unit is at most this many US dollars, e.g. 0.01. Listings without a known price are excluded when set.

min_trust.description: Only listings with a payment-verified trust score of at least this value (0-100). Excludes listings with no payment evidence.

paid_only.description: true = only listings that accept a payment rail (x402 or MPP).

q.description: What the agent needs, in plain words: 'web search', 'transcribe audio with speakers', 'postgres', 'token honeypot check'. Keywords beat full sentences.

rail.description: Only listings that accept this payment rail: x402 (USDC on-chain, per call) or mpp (Machine Payments Protocol).

sponsored.description: Set false to omit the labelled sponsored[] array. Default true.

name: search_kits

featured.description: Labelled Agentropolis Pro row, separate from organic results

results.description: Organic results: id, name, kind, summary, pricing, trust, badges, tiers, invoke, links (page, kit_manifest, call when relayable, go), buy (relay_x402 or link_out)

sponsored.description: Labelled Sponsored placements, hand-approved; separate from results; never affects ranking or trust. Usually empty.
